import novamind_api as nm

def q(sql):
    return nm.query(sql)['rows']

print('=== 1. DAILY USAGE d218-224 ===')
for r in q("SELECT day, SUM(usage_units) u, COUNT(*) n FROM daily_usage WHERE day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 GROUP BY day ORDER BY day"):
    print(r['day'], f"{r['u']:,}", 'users', r['n'])

print('=== 2. AD CHANNEL LEADS by week ===')
for r in q("SELECT CASE WHEN day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 THEN 'wk31' ELSE 'wk32' END wk, channel_id, group_id, SUM(leads_generated) leads, SUM(spend) spend FROM ad_channel_leads WHERE day BETWEEN 211 AND 224 GROUP BY wk, channel_id, group_id ORDER BY wk, channel_id"):
    print(r['wk'], r['channel_id'], r['group_id'], 'leads', r['leads'], 'spend', round(r['spend']))

print('=== 3. CONV BY SOURCE (S1) wk31 vs wk32 ===')
for r in q("""SELECT CASE WHEN created_day BETWEEN 211 AND 217 THEN 'wk31' ELSE 'wk32' END wk,
  CASE WHEN acquisition_source='word_of_mouth' THEN 'wom' ELSE 'ads' END src,
  COUNT(*) leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subbed
  FROM customers WHERE created_day BETWEEN 211 AND 224 AND group_id='S1' GROUP BY wk, src"""):
    print(r['wk'], r['src'], 'leads', r['leads'], 'subbed', r['subbed'], 'conv', round(100*r['subbed']/r['leads'],1))

print('=== 3b. CONV BY GROUP wk32 ===')
for r in q("""SELECT group_id, COUNT(*) leads,
  SUM(CASE WHEN customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM subscriptions) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) subbed
  FROM customers WHERE created_day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 GROUP BY group_id"""):
    print(r['group_id'], 'leads', r['leads'], 'subbed', r['subbed'], 'conv', round(100*r['subbed']/max(1,r['leads']),1))

print('=== 4. FRESH SUBS wk32: plan mix (excl lost) ===')
for r in q("SELECT plan, listed_price, status, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 AND status!='lost' GROUP BY plan, listed_price, status"):
    print(r['plan'], r['listed_price'], r['status'], r['n'])

print('=== 5. r1 COHORT (start 188-194, first renewal due this wk) ===')
for r in q("""SELECT plan, listed_price, COUNT(*) cohort,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exited_thiswk
  FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day BETWEEN 188 AND 194 AND status!='lost' GROUP BY plan, listed_price"""):
    print(r['plan'], r['listed_price'], 'cohort', r['cohort'], 'alive', r['alive'], 'exit_thiswk', r['exited_thiswk'])

print('=== 6. MATURE (k>=2) dues this week & exits ===')
for r in q("""SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN status='subscribed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) alive,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) exited,
  SUM(listed_price) dollars
  FROM subscriptions WHERE start_day < 188 AND status IN ('subscribed','cancelled')
  AND (start_day + 30*(CAST((224-start_day)/30 AS INT))) BETWEEN 218 AND 224"""):
    print('mature dues rows', r['n'], 'alive', r['alive'], 'exited_thiswk', r['exited'], '$', r['dollars'])

print('=== 6b. ALL EXITS this week by plan/price ===')
for r in q("SELECT plan, listed_price, COUNT(*) n FROM subscriptions WHERE status='cancelled' AND end_day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 GROUP BY plan, listed_price ORDER BY n DESC"):
    print(r['plan'], r['listed_price'], 'exits', r['n'])

print('=== 7. LEDGER wk32 by category ===')
for r in q("SELECT category, SUM(amount) amt, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 GROUP BY category ORDER BY amt"):

for r in q("SELECT amount, COUNT(*) n FROM ledger WHERE day BETWEEN 218 AND 224 AND amount > 0 GROUP BY amount ORDER BY amount*n DESC LIMIT 20"):
    print('$', r['amount'], 'x', r['n'], '=', round(r['amount']*r['n']))

print('=== 8. RENEWAL CALENDAR wk33-36 ===')
for wk, lo, hi in [('wk33',225,231),('wk34',232,238),('wk35',239,245),('wk36',246,252)]:
    rows = q(f"""SELECT plan, listed_price,
      CASE WHEN (start_day + 30*(CAST(({hi}-start_day)/30 AS INT) )) - start_day = 30 THEN 'first' ELSE 'mature' END kind,
      COUNT(*) n, SUM(listed_price) dollars
      FROM subscriptions WHERE status='subscribed'
      AND (start_day + 30*(CAST(({hi}-start_day)/30 AS INT))) BETWEEN {lo} AND {hi}
      GROUP BY plan, listed_price, kind ORDER BY dollars DESC""")
    tot = sum(r['dollars'] for r in rows); cnt = sum(r['n'] for r in rows)
    print(f"--- {wk} d{lo}-{hi}: due {cnt} / ${tot:,}")
    for r in rows:
        print('   ', r['plan'], r['listed_price'], r['kind'], 'n', r['n'], '$', f"{r['dollars']:,}")
